fourview._comment: build_prompts.py 用。character_block 是英文的逐件简化描述(照 templates/fourview/character_block.wren.txt 写);相对路径相对 workspace。
fourview.proportion_notes: Shoulder width about 2.0x face width. Hand width 0.5x face width. Thick-soled boots: boot length about 1.0x head height, sole thickness about 0.12x head height. She is the shortest in the roster.
fourview.identity_markers_en: twin-tails with wire-coil ties, fluoro-green open jacket, cylindrical glowing canister backpack with muzzle cap, blank ear tag, tool pouch on her right hip, over-knee boots with knee pads

view_notes.front: Both twin-tails visible left and right of the head, hanging outside the shoulders. The canister shows behind EACH shoulder with the muzzle cap rising above the shoulder line, plus the two dark straps on the chest. The ear tag is centered on the upper chest. The tool pouch is on HER RIGHT hip = IMAGE LEFT. Knee pads on both knees.
view_notes.left: Her LEFT twin-tail is the one fully visible, hanging beside the head in front of the canister, not overlapping it. The tool pouch is on her right hip, so it is NOT visible here. The canister sticks out toward the IMAGE RIGHT: round cylinder side, dark muzzle cap on top, base ring, strap over the shoulder.
view_notes.right: Her RIGHT twin-tail is the one fully visible. The tool pouch on her right hip faces the camera. The canister sticks out toward the IMAGE LEFT: round cylinder side, muzzle cap on top, base ring.
view_notes.back: The canister faces the camera squarely in the middle of the back: glass cylinder with glowing plants, muzzle cap with dark hollow on top, base ring, both straps. The twin-tails hang left and right of the canister without covering it. The tool pouch edge shows on the IMAGE RIGHT hip. No ear tag visible.

expressions.desc: EYES fully closed: each eye becomes one thick soft downward-curved dark lid line along the same position as the current upper lid, lashes merged into it. Eyebrows relaxed. Mouth: same small closed smile as input.
EYES half closed: the upper lids come down to cover the top half of the irises, relaxed sleepy look. Eyebrows relaxed. Mouth: same small closed smile as input.
Big open toothy grin: mouth wide open showing the upper teeth, corners pulled up. Eyes open and bright, slightly squinted by the smile. Eyebrows raised.
Pure joy: EYES closed into upward happy arcs (^ ^ shape, thick dark lines). Mouth: big open laughing smile showing upper teeth. Eyebrows raised high. Cheeks slightly lifted.
Smug: eyes half-lidded looking slightly sideways, one eyebrow raised, mouth a lopsided closed smirk.
Jealous pout: cheeks puffed, lips pushed into a small pout, eyes narrowed sideways, eyebrows pulled down at the inner ends.
Angry: eyebrows pulled down hard into a V, eyes narrowed, mouth a tight downturned line.
Sad: eyebrows raised at the inner ends, eyes looking down, mouth a small downturned wobbly line.
Focused aiming: both eyes narrowed and intent, one slightly more squinted, eyebrows lowered and level, small tongue tip at the mouth corner.
Knocked out: both eyes squeezed shut as dizzy X-like lines, eyebrows slanted in distress, mouth a small open wavy line.
